_comment: Canonical 999.md Ads_SearchInput filter serialization, captured from a real Firefox session 2026-05-24 (see docs/captured-filter-serialization.md). Golden reference for the source-adapter resolver (sub-project B). featureId/optionId/unit values come from src/data/filter-taxonomy.json.

rangeInt._example: rooms (Număr de camere) 2–4; min and max are independent strings

rangeUnit._example: total area (Suprafață totală) 50–200 m²; carries unit from the taxonomy filter's units[]

boolean._example: amenity (Adăugător) = Gata de mutat; bare featureId, presence means ON

price._example: price (Preț) 50000–180000; captured 2026-05-24 — serializes like a unit-range, currency is the unit (UNIT_EUR | UNIT_USD | UNIT_MDL)
